title: helichrysum helothamnus var. majus
intro: Helichrysum helothamnus var. majus, commonly known as the yellow Everlast flower, is a variety of the Helichrysum plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum helothamnus var. majus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant may also include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and support the immune system.
